title: Weymouth New Testament in Modern Speech, 1 Corinthians
summary: "Weymouth New Testament in Modern Speech, 1 Corinthians" by Richard Francis Weymouth is a Bible translation published in 1903. Weymouth aimed to discover how the New Testament's inspired writers would have expressed events if writing in nineteenth-century English. Based on his compilation of multiple Greek texts, this translation was prepared as a running commentary to accompany traditional versions. The work was edited posthumously by Reverend Ernest Hampden-Cook after Weymouth's death in 1902. (This is an automatically generated summary.)
